items.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet at APEC in Shenzhen
items.summary: The three leaders met at a welcome banquet for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in southern China ahead of their three-way talks.

items.headline: Israel launches new military operation in central Gaza
items.summary: Israeli forces advanced west of the so-called Yellow Line and took control of parts of Salah al-Din Road, with families fleeing Bureij and Nuseirat camps.

items.headline: US steps up pressure on Hezbollah with new sanctions
items.summary: Washington announced fresh sanctions on the Iran-backed Lebanese group.

items.headline: UK inflation rises to 3.6%, a one-year high
items.summary: Prices rose 3.6% in the year to October, up from 3.5% but below the 3.7% expected. Services inflation eased to 3.7%, under the Bank of England's 3.9% projection.
items.source: Alliance News via Yahoo Finance, 18 Nov

items.headline: Markets trim bets on a December rate rise
items.summary: After the softer-than-forecast inflation figure, traders cut the implied chance of a Bank of England rate rise in December to about 80% from 90%.

items.headline: FTSE 100 falls 1.3% as miners slump
items.summary: The index closed at 10,551.17, its third fall in a row. Mining shares were the six biggest fallers, led by Antofagasta, down 7.9%.

items.headline: Anthropic completes its stock market listing
items.summary: The Claude maker's shares were expected to price above the target range, with trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT from today.
items.source: Washington Post and AI Frontier Daily, 18 Nov

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary: The new flagship and everyday models come at lower prices, but OpenAI rates both at its 'Critical' cyber security level and some power users called them disappointing.

items.headline: US watchdog says chatbots helped plan attacks in tests
items.summary: Government Accountability Office investigators got Claude, Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini past their safeguards and produced workable attack plans within 12 hours.
